name: service-calls-new-en
query: Open a service call for {service_customer}: their label printer stops responding after every restart.
expected_behavior: Resolves the customer's CardCode live and uses it as the service call's customer
The proposed service call (receipt or payload) has a short Subject and the problem in the description
Only sets status/priority/type values it resolved live, or leaves them to SAP defaults
Asks the user only if something is ambiguous (several matching customers, a status or type it would have to guess); an unambiguous request may go straight to creating the call
